title: UI Refactor — Material Design 3 Style on shadcn/Tailwind

details: Refactor app/globals.css con nuova palette MD3-style. Risolvere Primary===Destructive. Aggiungere elevation system, state layers, color roles. Aggiornare DESIGN.md. Output: palette nuova, tokens CSS, DESIGN.md aggiornato. Verifica: build passa, dark mode ok.

description: Phase 2: Core components (button, card, input, dialog)
details: Refactor componenti base con MD3 principles. Button: nuove varianti, gerarchia chiara, destructive ≠ primary. Card: elevation, state layers. Input: focus states, a11y. Dialog: focus trap, aria-modal, mobile bottom-sheet. Output: componenti MD3-style. Verifica: screenshot, a11y audit.

Refactor app/layout.tsx. Aggiungere navigation persistente: mobile bottom bar, desktop top rail. Header con back button + title. Rimuovere WIP overlay o renderlo dismissibile. Breadcrumbs per lobby pages. Output: shell MD3. Verifica: navigation test, mobile test.
Refactor app/page.tsx. Ridurre CTA, migliorare gerarchia visiva. Applicare MD3 macrostructure. Typography refinement. Output: landing MD3. Verifica: screenshot, visual review.

Refactor app/lobby/[code]/page.tsx. Split in subcomponents per stati (waiting, playing, map-selection, closed). Bottom sheet modals su mobile. Semplificare UI, ridurre cognitive load. Empty states chiari. Output: lobby MD3. Verifica: user flow test.
Refactor app/submit/page.tsx e app/settings/. Form spacing, focus states, error states inline. Input validation MD3-style. Output: forms MD3. Verifica: form test, a11y.
Implementare ThemeProvider con zustand. Toggle dark/light. Persistenza localStorage. System preference detection. Output: theme toggle funzionante. Verifica: toggle test, persistence test.
